We help you navigate this shifting landscape. Governments are tempering the need for revenue with increased competition for labor and capital. Tax authorities are adapting their enforcement strategies, focus and policies in response to the changing dynamics of business. Companies are balancing competing priorities, ensuring they maintain compliance while adding value and help to effectively manage tax obligations by uncovering tax risks and opportunities. As a direct tax services professional at EY, you will handle engagements related to Direct Tax Laws, Appeals, Corporate Tax restructuring, Tax Advisory and consulting. Profile will also involve dealing with International Tax and treaties related matter and handling FEMA/RBI compliance. Good inter-personal skills, marketing skills and good acumen of client business is essential. The opportunity Due to continuing expansion we have new opportunities for ambitious individuals to join our Tax Team as Manager in Direct Tax practice. Your key responsibilities Develop and Implement accounts strategy for DT offerings targeted at clients within identified industry segments and market segments Develop and sell new solutions (managed services, distinct technology solutions etc.) for the DT practice as part of the GTM initiative Enhance internal and external awareness of EY DT services (branding) and support development of proposals/presentations etc as required Build strong relationships across all Service Lines and with the BD team to help surface new client opportunities and drive sales Periodic monitoring and reporting of sales opportunities, pipeline and wins Identify opportunities for other services and support in cross-sell for Tax, CoSec & other services Leading and coordinating the planning and management of assignments including pricing, billing and recovery, maximizing fee opportunities with guidance from the Partner. title: Senior Manager & Counsel, Operations - South Asia
description:
This is an in-house attorney position providing legal support in South Asia (India, Sri Lanka, Nepal and Bangladesh) to hotels operated by Hilton as well as business partners in Operations; to business partners in various departments (including development, operations and finance) in relation to hotel estate retention, amendment, interpretation, and owner relations matters; and generally, to support the Company s wider business affairs in South Asia, including compliance with laws, deployment and implementation of Hilton policies and procedures, and other general legal support. WHY YOU LL BE A GREAT FIT You have these minimum qualifications: Law degree from a common law jurisdiction Called to the bar in a common law jurisdiction 3-5 years of post-qualification experience in private practice and/or an in-house legal role. Strong foundation in corporate and commercial law, with knowledge of legal and regulatory frameworks and exposure to multi-jurisdictional matters in South Asia. Proven experience drafting, negotiating, and managing complex commercial transactions and contracts. High standards of professional ethics, integrity, judgment, and regulatory compliance. Fluent in spoken and written English, with flexibility to collaborate across global time zones. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook It would be useful if you have: Prior exposure to hospitality or hotel operations legal work Post-qualification experience in a law firm with some prior in-house legal experience exposure to legal frameworks in multiple jurisdictions Generalist with experience in general corporate and commercial law Transaction management experience including negotiating documents to conclusion Experience working for or advising MNCs Experience in managing a pool of very demanding clients Strong commercial awareness Good management skills in a multicultural, decentralized environment Effective communication skills, both verbally and in writing Ability to work irregular hours to accommodate global time differences Excellent interpersonal skills Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture At Hilton, we don t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests - we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality. Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we re setting new standards for the future of travel. Whether you re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career - and help us make every stay a little more magical. Curious about life at Hilton Explore our Careers Blog to see why we re more than a great place to stay - we re a great place to work. HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT Your role is important, and below are some of the fundamental job duties that make your work unique. What your day-to-day will be like: Provide advice relating to day-to-day hotel operations. Assist in retention matters and drafting of Management Agreements and Franchise Agreements. Assist and/or oversee assistance to business partners with drafting, negotiating, or counseling on business-critical matters in a manner consistent with Hilton policies, procedures, forms and past practice and with the highest level of legal service, and/or obtaining local counsel advice where business partners have additional legal needs Provide legal support for ongoing operational matters across South Asia, including marketing, advertising, promotions, hotel operations, compliance with laws, and deployment of Hilton policies and procedures. Draft, review and, where appropriate, negotiate standard form contracts such as confidentiality agreements, services agreements and sales agreements, taking into account business requirements, legal requirements, and Hilton policies and procedures. Ensure a high standard of frontline and local backup support and implementation for other business and legal areas, including Compliance, Corporate, Brands Commercial Services, Employment and Dispute Resolution, and partnering with Legal Department colleagues in APAC, EMEA and US where needed Develop and implement legal strategies to address operational issues. Under the direction and supervision of senior attorneys, provide advice to business partners in accordance with Hilton s policies, procedures and past practices, so similar matters are handled consistently and directly. Conduct training and prepare practical guidance on areas of expertise, including how to prepare and use form contracts and how to manage recurring operational, marketing and commercial legal issues consistently. How you will collaborate with others: Partner with hotel-level and corporate business partners to provide practical legal support and frontline guidance. Collaborate with Legal Department colleagues in APAC, EMEA and the U. S. to ensure advice is aligned with Hilton policies, procedures, forms and past practice. Work directly with outside counsel, counterparties counsel, vendors and outsourced professionals as needed. What you will take ownership of: Maintain and improve standard form contracts, legal guidelines, educational tools and reference materials, including ensuring the latest approved form contracts are uploaded to the appropriate repositories and available for business partner use.

title: Senior Manager - NBFC Compliance
description:
MobiKwik is one of India's leading Digital Financial Services platforms, serving over 167 million users and 4.4 million businesses. As a key player in fintech, MobiKwik offers services across digital payments, credit, and investments, with a strong focus on financial inclusion and regulatory governance. The position is with our subsidiary entity, MobiKwik Financial Services Private Limited, which is the NBFC.
 About the Role: 
 This role will be responsible for managing and strengthening the regulatory compliance framework for the NBFC business, ensuring adherence to RBI regulations and other applicable laws. The incumbent will work closely with business, product, risk, and operations teams to ensure all lending products, customer journeys, and processes are compliant with regulatory requirements. The role also includes managing regulatory reporting, audits, and engagement with regulators.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Regulatory Compliance & Advisory: 
 - Ensure end-to-end compliance with RBI regulations applicable to NBFC, including guidelines on digital lending, responsible business conduct, prudential norms, co-lending, etc.
 - Monitor and implement regulatory circulars, notifications, and guidelines issued by RBI and other relevant authorities.
 - Provide advisory support to lending, credit, product, and operations teams to ensure compliant product structures and customer journeys.
 - Ensure adherence to KYC, AML, Fair Practices Code, outsourcing guidelines, and digital lending norms.
 Reporting & Framework: 
 - Oversee regulatory reporting and filings (returns, disclosures, etc.) ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
 - Design, implement, and periodically update compliance policies/framework, SOPs, and internal control frameworks.
 - Maintain strong governance and handle regulatory escalations and critical compliance issues.
 Audits & Regulatory Engagement: 
 - Manage and coordinate RBI inspections, internal audits, and compliance reviews.
 - Liaise with RBI and other regulatory bodies for submissions, clarifications, and compliance matters.
 - Lead regulatory readiness for audits, inspections, circular changes, and enforcement actions.
 Operations & Risk Monitoring: 
 - Monitor and ensure timely resolution of customer grievances as per regulatory timelines.
 - Drive compliance monitoring, risk mitigation, and regulatory change management initiatives.
 - Conduct rigorous testing and assessments to ensure all operational processes remain in full alignment with industry regulations and legal requirements.
 - Proactively identify potential compliance gaps or risks within workflows and implement corrective actions to protect the organization from legal or financial liabilities.
 - Maintain meticulous documentation of all testing procedures and prepare comprehensive reports for internal stakeholders and external regulatory bodies.
